summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Memind AI dementia care platform. All 4 role experiences (Patient, Caregiver, Doctor, Admin) are functional with working navigation, AI integrations, and EN/DE language support. Backend APIs responding correctly, real LLM integration working via OpenAI gpt-5-nano.

backend_issues.notes: AI endpoints (daily-summary, recommendations, clinical-observations, report, memory-recall, confusion-support) take 10-30 seconds due to real LLM calls, which is expected behavior. All endpoints return 200 OK status.
